subject: POC success criteria & evaluation plan - Atlas Payments
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@atlas-payments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 14:10:00 -0800
Subject: POC success criteria & evaluation plan - Atlas Payments

Alex — great convo earlier, thanks for the time. This is a short post-call recap + proposed POC plan and success criteria so we can align on expectations before we spin up the trial.

Summary of ask (from your side):
- Validate Redwood inference for real-time payments fraud alerts and memo generation across 3 product lanes (Risk Scoring, Case Summaries, Agent Assist).
- Measure latency and throughput under expected peak windows and estimate per-token cost for live inference.

Proposed POC (4 weeks):
1) Scope & onboarding (Week 0 - 1): dataset sampling, private test endpoint, network/egress checklist. Owners: Jordan (sales) + Marissa (solutions).
2) Load & latency testing (Week 2): synthetic traffic to simulate peak of ~200 qps sustained, 500 qps bursts. Measure p50/p95/p99 latency. Owner: Marissa.
3) Quality evaluation (Week 2-3): run 1k labeled prompts across each product lane; measure precision/recall or human pass rates vs your baseline. Owner: Atlas (Priya) + Redwood analytics.
4) Cost analysis & recommendations (Week 3-4): quantify cost/token on selected quantization/profile and recommend batching/cache settings. Owner: Jordan + Redwood Optimize.
5) Wrap & decision (end Week 4): go/no-go + next steps for Dedicated or Private deployment.

Success criteria (please confirm or edit):
- Latency: p95 end-to-end inference latency <= 250ms for short prompts (<= 256 tokens) under target load.
- Throughput: sustain 200 QPS with <5% tail latency violations; handle 500 QPS bursts for at least 5 minutes.
- Cost: inference cost <= $0.0006 per token (network and infra excluded) or candidate profile that reduces cost by 30% vs baseline.
- Quality: >90% human pass rate on sample prompts for core agent-assist templates OR no more than 10% regression vs your current baseline on key metrics.
- Operational: successful authentication via your VPC peering, and access to necessary audit logs and latency traces.

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan.xlsx (POC milestones / checklist / tooling), sample prompt set included.

Next steps: if the above looks good, can we confirm signed NDA + access to a small dataset subset by EOD Monday so Marissa can start the test endpoint? Also confirm preferred times for a short kickoff (30m) next week.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@atlas-payments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Kumar <priya.k@atlas-payments.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 16:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: POC success criteria & evaluation plan - Atlas Payments

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap. Appreciate the structure. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Latency: our hard requirement for agent-assist is p95 <= 200ms for short prompts; 250ms is acceptable for risk-scoring batch-like calls. Can you confirm whether p95 is measured at the Redwood edge (post-network) or end-to-end from our client? We need end-to-end metrics.
2) Throughput: 200 QPS sustained is in line with our forecasts. For the burst test, can you add a 1-minute spike test at 1,000 QPS to validate graceful degradation?
3) Cost: our procurement target is <$0.0005/token. We understand network egress will be extra; please include quantized model estimates.
4) Dataset: we'll provide a 2,000-sample subset (anonymized) for quality evaluations. Priya will share a secure link.

We can get the NDA signed today. Priya — can you drop the dataset link into this thread? Also, we're available for kickoff Tue 1/20 10:00-11:30 PT or Wed 1/21 8:00-10:00 PT.

Attachments: none in this reply.

Cheers,
Alex
Product Lead — Risk & Ops
Atlas Payments
alex.johnson@atlas-payments.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@atlas-payments.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC success criteria & evaluation plan - Atlas Payments

Alex — looping in a couple of implementation notes from the infra side: 

- End-to-end vs edge: we will instrument both. By default Redwood reports server-side (post-ingress) latencies; for E2E you'll get a client-side trace GUID we can correlate to show total wall-clock. That should cover your E2E ask.
- Load testing: we will run the 1,000 QPS 1-minute spike and the longer 500 QPS 5-minute burst. We will capture p50/p95/p99 and error rates, and surface them in the console.
- Cost estimates: attaching a quick network/architecture checklist. Also: for cost/token ballpark numbers we will run quantized profiles (int8/4bit) and surface recommendations.

Attaching: network-topology.pdf (network checklist + peering steps)

Action items from Redwood:
- Jordan to circulate final POC plan and grant access to the test endpoint after NDA.
- Marissa to schedule load test windows and set up tracing hooks (ETA 2 business days after dataset access).
- Lauren to prep eval scripts and template pass/fail rubric.

I'll schedule kickoff Tue 1/20 10:30 PT unless I hear otherwise.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering Lead
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: network-topology.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Team — confirmed. NDA signed (sent via DocuSign), Priya posted the anonymized 2k sample here: https://secure.atlas-payments.com/s/poctest/2k (S3 presigned link). We've confirmed Tue 1/20 10:30 PT for kickoff — thanks Marissa for scheduling.

Accepting the success criteria with two small edits:
- Latency p95 target for agent-assist set to 200ms E2E.
- Cost target: target <$0.0005/token for production profile; for trial we accept up to $0.0006/token while you evaluate quantization options.

Owners: Jordan (commercial), Marissa (technical lead), Priya (data & quality).

Looking forward to the kickoff.

Alex
